reserveReview.rationale: Re-reviewed 2026-08-29. The live JupUSD data endpoint currently returns positive USDtb and USDC holdings only; the response sums to 44,791,782.679719 USDtb and 3,552,440.966654 USDC (92.6518% / 7.3482% of the returned holdings). The timestamped snapshots endpoint also responds, with its newest observed entry at 2026-08-26T16:00:23.988Z and the same two reserve identities. Jupiter's documentation identifies USDtb and USDC as the reserve collateral. The runtime adapter owns these volatile live percentages; to avoid date-bumping a static composition from an undated API response, the curated July 14 snapshot rows and compositionAsOf remain unchanged. Both reviewed rows are mapped to tracked upstream stablecoins and the live response contains no unknown holding.
